title: Page 9
lines: 在满山遍野一片枫红盛开之际，竟然可见朱色回廊尽头处探出的一片粉樱。
“是品种珍贵稀有的十月樱，喜欢吗？”齐藤英树瞧她惊诧又惊喜的眼神，淡淡地提了一句。
“喜欢就全买给我吗？”席舞笑咪咪地看着他。
“嗯，你要什么给什么。”
“对我这么好？不怕被我骗光光？”
“我人和心都是你的了，还有什么怕你骗？”齐藤英树好笑地看着她，下了车，齐藤家的新管家和仆人都忙奔出来。
“夫人好。”众人齐声，连头都不敢抬。
席舞看了齐藤英树一眼，对这样的称呼感到很害羞又不好意思，不由得嗔道：“谁嫁你啦？”
齐藤英树听了却笑意满满，神采飞扬。
席舞愿意跟他回日本，是他们之间的一大步，当时他感激又开心地笑得合不拢嘴，连黑咖啡喝起来都是甜的。
行李有点多，大家忙着搬东西，刚好齐藤英树接了一通电话，一时半刻好像讲不完，席舞信步走着，往那印象中十月樱所在的尽头行去。
傍晚时分，可能大家都在厨房及各大院里忙活去了，倒是没见到什么人，当席舞终于看见了那比一般樱花大些的十月樱，也同时看见站在一旁的赏花人似乎听到足音，那人稍稍回过头来看了一眼，只一眼，席舞便认出那人是安本香子。
安本香子也看见她了，原本美丽婉约的面容在一瞬间转为惊恐，她吓得惊慌失措，跌坐在泥泞的地上，连话都说不出口。“你……你……”
席舞微笑着一步步走向她，伸手想将她从泥地上拉起，安本香子却在此时疯狂地尖叫——
“不要过来！你已经死了！舞冬末！你都已经死了那么久了，你到底来这里干什么？”她叫得很大声，是发自骨子里的畏惧。
席舞还是淡淡地笑着，轻轻地对她开了口。“当然是报仇啊，一命抵一命，很公平是不？”
“不！那是你罪有应得，怨不得我！”安本香子又叫又哭。“谁叫你要勾引我的浅羽？那几日他夜夜在你房里，以为神不知鬼不觉吗？他是我的！你又不爱他，为什么要勾引他？你死了活该！你是罪有应得！跟我一点关系也没有！你听见没有？是你自己一脚踩空摔下去的，不是我把你推下去的，不是我！你凭什么来找我报仇？我香也拜了，纸钱也烧了，你没收到吗？你要多少，我可以再烧给你！你说你要多少啊？”
风吹来，有点凉意，席舞只是静静地看着她，一句话也没有再说。
对安本香子，不是没有过恨，如果说齐藤英树造成她心里的伤，那安本香子所造成的，则是她长达一年多的身体的伤。那一年，要不是她因嫉生恨把她约到山崖边说话，再出其不意地将她推落山崖，她也不必躺在医院里大半年，还得日日辛苦做复健，甚至不得不在脸上动刀……
可，也因为安本香子，她得以有勇气选择重生，把这里的一切抛下，重新当另一个女人。
就算到头来她还是回到了这里，还是回到了齐藤英树的怀抱，可走过必留下痕迹，至少，她是心甘情愿地回来，至少，她是因为爱而回来，而不是因为被迫与恨。
午夜梦回想到过去时，或许还是会痛，但她的痛会很快被某人的爱给充满而抚平，直到她遗忘的那天。
想着，席舞轻轻地笑了。前尘往事，她本不欲再计较，刚刚也只是出一口恶气罢了，没想到香子激动成那样，看样子倒是个犀利的，明明她的模样已有大半不同，香子却是一眼就认定了她便是舞冬末。
唉，是因为做了亏心事，所以更加耳清目明吗？
席舞转身想离开，却看见不知何时站在她身后的齐藤浅羽——是的，她一眼就认出来了，不只是因为发型和服装，还有他看着她的神情，错愕又迷惑，不是齐藤英树的气定神闲。
“冬末？”他眼神复杂地看着她。因为他刚刚听见香子把她当成舞冬末，而这个女人身上确实有舞冬末的影子，不管是背影还是神态……虽然，她长得跟舞冬末其实有点不一样。
“不，我是席舞。”
“席舞？你就是大哥的——”
“未婚妻。”席舞微笑地看着他。“你应该就是浅羽了吧？那个英树的双胞胎弟弟？”
“那这位是……”
“我的妻子，安本香子。”说完，齐藤浅羽瞬也不瞬地望住她。“她刚刚好像对你说了什么？”
此时，安本香子看见齐藤浅羽，忙冲过来紧紧抱住他。“浅羽，你也看得见她吗？她是鬼对不对？你告诉她，我没有害她……”
齐藤浅羽伸手拍拍她。“知道了，别怕。”
席舞一笑，看着他。“她可能认错人了，看到我就一直尖叫，你快把她带下去休息吧。真对不起，我好像吓到她了，我不是有意的。”
“你千万不要这么说，未来的嫂子。”齐藤浅羽恭敬地对她一福。“香子近几年的情绪不大稳定，有时会产生一些幻影幻听，若有冒犯之处，请多见谅。”
席舞闻言，目光再次落到安本香子脸上，只见她还是害怕地瞪着她，双手紧紧抓着齐藤浅羽的胳臂。
有时会产生幻听幻影？
她病了？虽然没有受到法律的制裁，她却没有逃掉她自个儿良心的谴责，是吧？
席舞望着安本香子的眼神，不禁流露出一丝哀伤与叹息。
“我先带她回房了。”
齐藤浅羽拉着安本香子的手往屋里走，转角处，他回头望了院中的女人一眼，那女人仰头看着樱花，笑得一脸恬静，彷佛刚刚那场混乱丝毫没有影响到她，脸上波纹不兴。
是错觉吧？虽然香子识人的本事一流，这回怕也失误了。
若舞冬末真的活着回来了，齐藤家能不兴风雨吗？
轻轻一叹，齐藤浅羽拉着安本香子的手消失在转角处。
齐藤英树从另一道拱门处走出，走到樱花树下由后轻轻圈抱住席舞。“我有告诉过你，我有一个双胞胎弟弟叫浅羽吗？”
“有啊，你忘了？”她回眸对他轻笑。
“嗯，忘了。”
她笑了笑。“没关系，你什么都可以忘掉，只要不要忘了你爱我，我爱你，这样就好。”
“嗯，知道了。”
“约定了就一辈子不可以忘记。”
“嗯，约定了。我一辈子都不会忘记。”他应声许诺。
风吹过，落下的樱花飘散在他们之间。
时间彷佛停住了，停在九年前，心动那一年。
经过刚刚香子那一闹，很多事突然豁然开朗了——
他懂了，懂得她不认她是舞冬末，是为了让每个人都可以藉此忘掉过去，再次幸福。
她永远就是那么善良那么可爱那么宽容的女孩……
不管她是舞冬末，还是席舞。
终曲 玫瑰项链
齐藤家的大宅，贺礼盈门，宾客云集，花团锦簇，一场盛大的户外婚礼在红花遍野的时节里展开。
新娘子一身鱼尾白纱曳地而洒，镜子里的席舞，长发绾成一个髻，上头簪着一朵十月樱，清丽典雅。
左语恩在旁看着，不由发出赞叹。“席舞你真美啊，连我都要看呆了。”
席舞好笑地看着她。“如果我嫁的是黑少，你还会这么说吗？”
“喂，你什么意思？”左语恩脸突然红了，伸手扶了扶眼镜。“说得我好像见色忘友一样！”
“你是啊，那天晚上听到我要嫁黑少，就把我一个人丢在酒吧里不顾我死活了。”席舞忍不住取笑她。
content_en:
When maples are in full bloom all over the mountains and plains, you can actually see a pink cherry blossom peeking out from the end of the vermilion corridor.
"It's a precious and rare October cherry blossom. Do you like it?" Saito Hideki looked at her surprised and surprised eyes and asked lightly.
"If you like it, buy it all for me?" Xi Wu looked at him with a smile.
"Well, I'll give you what you want."
"You are so good to me? Aren't you afraid of being deceived by me?"
"I and my heart are all yours, why should I be afraid of you lying to me?" Saito Hideki looked at her funny, got out of the car, and the Saito family's new housekeeper and servants all hurried out.
"Hello, madam." Everyone shouted in unison, not even daring to raise their heads.
Xi Wu glanced at Saito Hideki, feeling shy and embarrassed by such a title, and couldn't help but said angrily: "Who married you?"
Saito Hideki was full of smiles and in high spirits after hearing this.
Xi Wu's willingness to go back to Japan with him was a big step between them. At that time, he was so grateful and happy that he smiled from ear to ear. Even the black coffee tasted sweet.
Chapter 19(2)
There was a lot of luggage, and everyone was busy moving things. It happened that Saito Hideki answered a phone call. It seemed that he couldn't finish talking for a while. Xi Wu walked leisurely towards the end of the impression where the October Sakura was.
In the evening, everyone may have been busy in the kitchen and the courtyard, but no one was seen. When Xi Wu finally saw the October cherry blossoms, which were larger than ordinary cherry blossoms, he also saw the flower-viewer standing nearby who seemed to hear footsteps. The person turned around slightly and took a look. With just one glance, Xi Wu recognized the person as Kyouko Yasumoto.
Xiangzi Yasumoto also saw her, and her originally beautiful and graceful face turned to panic in an instant. She was so frightened that she fell to the muddy ground and couldn't even speak. "You...you..."
Xi Wu smiled and walked towards her step by step, reaching out to pull her up from the mud, but at this moment Xiangzi Yasumoto screamed crazily——
"Don't come here! You're already dead! Wu Dongmo! You've been dead for so long, what are you doing here?" She screamed loudly, with fear coming from her bones.
Xi Wu still smiled lightly and spoke to her gently. "Of course it's revenge. One life is worth another life. It's fair, right?"
"No! You deserve it, you can't blame me!" Xiangzi Yasumoto screamed and cried. "Who told you to seduce my Qianyu? Those few days when he was in your room every night, did you think he was unnoticed? He is mine! You don't love him, why do you want to seduce him? You deserve to die! You deserve it! You have nothing to do with me! Do you hear that? Yes? It was you who pushed you down, not me! Why did you come to me to take revenge? I also burned the incense, didn’t you receive it? I can burn it for you as much as you want!”
The wind was blowing, making it a bit chilly, but Xi Wu just looked at her quietly without saying a word.
It’s not that she has no hatred for Kouko Yasumoto. If Hideki Saito caused her psychological injury, then Kouko Yasumoto caused her physical injury for more than a year. That year, if she hadn't asked her to talk to a cliff out of jealousy, and then unexpectedly pushed her off the cliff, she wouldn't have had to lie in the hospital for more than half a year, have to work hard for rehabilitation every day, and even have to have a knife on her face...
But, because of Xiangzi Yasumoto, she had the courage to choose to be reborn, leave everything here behind, and become another woman again.
Even if she came back here in the end, or returned to Saito Hideki's arms, she would leave traces when she walked by. At least, she came back willingly. At least, she came back because of love, not because of force or hatred.
When Midnight Dream recalls the past, it may still hurt, but her pain will soon be filled with someone's love and healed until the day she forgets.
Thinking about it, Xi Wu smiled softly. She didn't want to worry about the past, she just let out a bad breath just now, but she didn't expect Xiangzi to be so excited, she looked sharp, her appearance was obviously different, but Xiangzi recognized her as Wu Dongsue at a glance.
Alas, is it because you have done something wrong that your ears and eyesight are clearer?
Xi Wu turned around and wanted to leave, but she saw Saito Asaba standing behind her at some point - yes, she recognized him at a glance, not only because of his hairstyle and clothes, but also because of the way he looked at her, surprised and confused, not the calmness of Saito Hideki.
"Late winter?" He looked at her with complicated eyes. Because he just heard that Xiangzi regarded her as Wu Dongsue, and this woman did have the shadow of Wu Dongsue, whether it was the back or the expression... Although, she actually looked a little different from Wu Dongsue.
"No, I am Xi Wu."
"Xi Wu? You are the eldest brother's -"
"Fiancée." Xi Wu looked at him with a smile. "You must be Qian Yu, right? That Hideki's twin brother?"
"Yes."
"Then this is..."
"My wife, Koko Yasumoto." After saying that, Saito Asaha looked at her without blinking an eye. "What did she say to you just now?"
At this time, Koko Yasumoto saw Saito Asaha and rushed over to hug him tightly. "Qianyu, can you also see her? She is a ghost, right? Tell her that I did not harm her..."
Saito Asayu reached out and patted her. "I know, don't be afraid."
Xi Wu smiled and looked at him. "She may have recognized the wrong person. She kept screaming when she saw me. Please take her down to rest quickly. I'm really sorry. I seemed to have scared her. I didn't mean to."
"You must not say that, future sister-in-law." Saito Asayu greeted her respectfully. "Xiangzi's mood has been unstable in recent years, and she sometimes experiences phantoms and auditory hallucinations. Please forgive me for any offense."
Hearing this, Xi Wu's eyes fell on Yasumoto Kyouko's face again, only to see her still staring at her in fear, holding Saito Asaha's arm tightly with both hands.
Do you sometimes have auditory hallucinations?
Is she sick? Although she was not punished by the law, she did not escape the condemnation of her own conscience, right?
Xi Wu looked at Xiangzi Yasumoto's eyes, and couldn't help but reveal a trace of sadness and sigh.
"I'll take her back to the room first."
"Yeah."
Saito Asaha took Yasumoto Kouko's hand and walked into the house. When he turned the corner, he turned back and glanced at the woman in the courtyard. The woman looked up at the cherry blossoms with a peaceful smile on her face, as if the chaos just now did not affect her at all, and her face was unfazed.
Is it an illusion? Although Xiangzi's ability to recognize people is first-rate, she might have made a mistake this time.
If Wu Dongmo really comes back alive, can the Saito family avoid trouble?
With a slight sigh, Saito Asaha took Yasumoto Kyouko's hand and disappeared around the corner.
Saito Hideki walked out of another archway, walked under the cherry blossom tree, and gently hugged Xi Wu from behind. "Did I tell you that I have a twin brother named Qianyu?"
"Yes, have you forgotten?" She looked back and smiled at him.
"Well, I forgot."
She smiled. "It doesn't matter, you can forget everything, as long as you don't forget that you love me and I love you, that's fine."
"Yeah, got it."
"If you make a promise, you can't forget it for the rest of your life."
"Yes, it's agreed. I will never forget it in my life." He promised.
The wind blew, and the fallen cherry blossoms were scattered between them.
Time seems to have stopped, nine years ago, the year that made my heart beat.
After Xiangzi’s trouble just now, many things suddenly became clear——
He understood that she did not recognize her as Wu Dongmo, so that everyone could forget the past and be happy again.
She is always such a kind, lovely and tolerant girl...
No matter she is dancing in the late winter or dancing in the Xi dance.
Finale Rose Necklace
The Saito family's mansion was filled with gifts, guests gathered, and flowers bloomed. A grand outdoor wedding unfolded in a season filled with red flowers.
The bride is dressed in a fishtail white gauze that is flowing on the floor. She is dancing in the mirror. Her long hair is tied into a bun with an October cherry blossom on top. She is beautiful and elegant.
Zuo Yuen looked on and couldn't help but admire. "Xi Wu, you are so beautiful, even I am stunned."
Xi Wu looked at her funny. "If I married Mr. Hei, would you still say this?"
"Hey, what do you mean?" Zuo Yuen's face suddenly turned red and he stretched out his hand to adjust his glasses. "It sounds like I've forgotten my friends after seeing sex!"
"You are right. When you heard that I was going to marry Young Master Hei that night, you left me alone in the bar and didn't care about my life or death." Xi Wu couldn't help but tease her.
